name: Text Tools
description: Bounded text transformation, extraction, analysis, conversion, date/time, developer, document, table, and command-wrapper tools.
capabilities: convert between JSON, JSONL, YAML, CSV, TOML, INI, XML, dotenv and query strings
stream and reshape large CSV files from shared artifact storage
compare, merge, flatten and infer schemas for JSON
run, test and explain regular expressions safely
scan text for credentials and redact emails, IPs and secrets
parse, reformat and convert timestamps, timezones and durations
inspect invisible characters, line endings and encoding problems
split, chunk and restructure Markdown documents
extract emails, URLs, IPs, UUIDs, hashes and versions from text
hash, checksum, and generate UUIDs, passwords and passphrases
search and reshape text with ripgrep, jq, awk and sed
